title: Contradictory source fixture
scope: Fixture and structural validation only; validator semantics are unchanged and no source-truth oracle is claimed.

method.verification: Run the unchanged validator twice and compare exit status and output.
method.label_basis: Labels are fixed by the fixture's explicitly stated primary process observations and are not independently adjudicated source truth.

finding.result: The record shape can preserve a primary/secondary conflict without silently choosing a winner.
finding.limit: The unchanged validator checks structure only; it neither detects contradiction nor establishes which source is correct.
finding.next_step: Keep contradiction handling as an explicit review input; do not turn source agreement or priority into automatic enforcement.
